method: Ranks blend 2026 production and efficiency (weighted most for players with a real role), 2025 production, recruiting pedigree, size and frame where verified, and depth-chart/landing context, with a superflex bump for QBs who start and project as possible first- or second-round NFL picks. Consensus devy boards (KeepTradeCut, FantasyPros Aug 2026, Draft Sharks Jul 2026, FantraxHQ Aug 2026) were the starting point, and I moved players off consensus only where the 2026 tape-of-record (stats, injuries, starting status) clearly changed the picture. Class assignment uses NFL eligibility (3 years removed from high school): 2025 HS grads (true sophomores and redshirt freshmen in 2026) are the 2028 class, and 2026 HS grads, including reclassified early enrollees, are the 2029 class. 2026 stats were refreshed Nov. 25 from cfbstats.com, Ourlads and game logs (mostly through Weeks 12-13); each line says how many games it covers.

2028.class_note: Draft Sharks and FantraxHQ list him as a 2025 recruit (2028 class); his Wikipedia page lists him as class of 2024 (247 No. 88). He enrolled at Oregon in Jan 2025 and left after 32 days, so 2028 eligibility is consistent, but confirm his HS graduation year.
2028.hs_rank: 4-star (On3 No. 20 per Wikipedia's 2025 class table; Wikipedia's player page lists 247 No. 88 / No. 9 QB)
2028.stats_2026: 9 g (cfbstats, through Wk 11): 194/294 (66.0%), 1,892 yds, 11 TD, 8 INT, 6.4 YPA; 28 rush, -93 yds, 0 TD (cfbstats; an earlier source credited 3 rush TD)
2028.stats_2025: 13 g: 316/492, 3,454 yds, 18 TD, 9 INT (most passing yards by a true freshman)
2028.notes: His second season has been flat (6.4 YPA, 11:8 TD:INT) on a weak Cal team, and he missed the 10/10 Virginia Tech game with a concussion. He gives you nothing as a runner. His frame and two-year starter résumé keep him in tier 2, but he falls from 5 to 7 (KTC QB11, No. 37 overall devy).

2028.name: Caleb Hawkins
2028.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Wk 11): 205 rush, 1,172 yds, 7 TD, 5.7 YPC; 45 rec, 476 yds, 3 TD
2028.stats_2025: North Texas: 230 rush, 1,434 yds, 25 TD (nation's most)
2028.notes: He got much better as the season went on, with 194 yds at Iowa State and 175 yds plus 3 TD at Kansas State. His 45 catches give him one of the best receiving roles of any RB in the class. He moves up from 10 to 8 (KTC RB10).

2028.name: Donovan Olugbode
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 52 rec, 796 yds, 10 TD
2028.notes: He kept producing in SEC play (9-127 at Ole Miss, 5-105-2 vs Kentucky) and has 10 TD in 11 games with an outside-receiver frame. His production is now second only to Toney among the class's WRs. The market still lags (KTC WR42), so he is a buy, and he moves up from 13 to 9.

2028.name: Bear Bachmeier
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 185/299 (61.9%), 2,299 yds, 14 TD, 8 INT, 7.7 YPA; rushing through Wk 11: 103 rush, 449 yds, 10 TD
2028.stats_2025: 3,033 pass yds, 15 TD, 7 INT; 527 rush yds; 26 total TD
2028.notes: His 10 rushing TDs give him a solid superflex floor, but his passing has been uneven (4 INTs at Utah, 104 yds vs Baylor). Draft Sharks has called his arm strength below average, which limits his NFL projection. He moves up mostly because QBs above him fell (KTC QB15).

2028.name: Braden Atkinson
2028.class_note: He was a 2025 HS grad who played as a true freshman at Mercer (FCS) and transferred to Oregon State, so he is 2028 eligible. KTC lists him among its 2028 names.
2028.stats_2026: 9 g (cfbstats, through Wk 10): 242/368 (65.8%), 3,169 yds, 25 TD, 3 INT, 8.6 YPA; 35 rush, -7 yds, 2 TD. Missed 11/14 vs Boise State (hand)
2028.notes: He led the nation in passing yards through nine games, but cooled off late (1 TD in his last two games) and hurt his hand vs Texas State on 11/7, missing the Boise State game. He re-signed with Oregon State for 2027 on 11/10. His modest size and lack of pedigree keep the market cautious (KTC QB28), so he slips from 9 to 11.

2028.name: JJ Buchanan
2028.class_note: FantraxHQ lists him as a 2028 TE; KTC and StatSniper list him as a WR. Check his position designation on your platform.
2028.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Wk 11; no catches vs Oregon 11/14): 40 rec, 646 yds, 5 TD
2028.notes: He was Michigan's most productive receiver (16.2 yds per catch) despite the team's QB chaos. FantraxHQ lists him at TE, which would make him the top TE in the class in TE-premium leagues. He moves up from 19 to 12 (KTC WR39).

2028.name: Dallas Wilson
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 41 rec, 517 yds, 3 TD
2028.notes: He has prototype X-receiver size and five-star pedigree, but he has not scored since 10/3 and has had more than 50 yds in only one game since. He has stayed healthy while Vernell Brown III was out, so he cannot blame target competition. He holds on pedigree (KTC WR22).

2028.name: Talyn Taylor
2028.hs_rank: 5-star (per Approaching the Pros); On3 No. 28 overall, No. 5 WR (2025)
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 30 rec, 537 yds, 6 TD
2028.notes: He made big plays on limited volume, including 4-140-3 at Ole Miss on 11/7 and 4-110-1 vs Oklahoma. Georgia still spreads the ball around, which caps his volume at about 3 catches per game. His efficiency (17.9 yds per catch) and TD rate move him up from 25 to 14.

2028.name: Malik Washington
2028.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 211/346 (61.0%), 2,309 yds, 11 TD, 10 INT, 6.7 YPA; 55 rush, 172 yds, 5 TD
2028.notes: He is a two-year starter with an NFL frame, but his efficiency is poor (6.7 YPA, 11:10 TD:INT). He missed the 11/14 Wisconsin game with a lower-body injury (he warmed up in a left knee brace) and played again on 11/21. The market values him more than his production (KTC QB23), so he moves up slightly as QBs around him fell.

2028.name: Bryce Underwood
2028.hs_rank: 5-star; No. 1 overall 2025 on 247Sports, ESPN and On3
2028.stats_2026: 9 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 85/156 (54.5%), 1,077 yds, 6 TD, 6 INT, 6.9 YPA; 76 rush, 230 yds, 2 TD
2028.stats_2025: 2,428 pass yds, 11 TD, 9 INT; 392 rush yds, 6 TD
2028.notes: He was benched at halftime vs Penn State on 10/17 for true freshman Tommy Carr and has since been used mostly as a runner or in a rotation (2/8 for 26 yds at Oregon on 11/14). Michigan fired its OC after a loss to Michigan State, and the starting job is unsettled. The tools and No. 1 recruit pedigree are still there, but he falls from 7 to 16 (KTC QB31).

2028.name: Mason Heintschel
2028.stats_2026: 5 g (cfbstats; season over): 98/148 (66.2%), 1,304 yds, 14 TD, 1 INT; 30 rush, 112 yds, 1 TD. Tore his ACL at Virginia Tech on 10/2
2028.notes: He tore his ACL in the 10/2 win at Virginia Tech and is out for the season, which the 10/30 version missed. Before the injury he had big games against weak opponents (7 TD vs Miami (OH), 6 TD vs Bucknell) but struggled against UCF and Syracuse. He is no longer in KTC's top 42 devy QBs, so he falls from 8 to 17 as a recovery stash.

2028.name: Andrew Marsh
2028.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Wk 11): 48 rec, 459 yds, 1 TD
2028.notes: He has steady volume but is capped by Michigan's broken passing game (9.6 yds per catch, 1 TD). Buchanan has passed him as Michigan's most productive receiver. He is still a buy if Michigan's QB play improves in 2027 (KTC WR26).

2028.name: Ousmane Kromah
2028.stats_2026: 7 g (cfbstats; season over): 114 rush, 609 yds, 5 TD. Season-ending ankle surgery after getting hurt at Miami on 10/17
2028.notes: He was FSU's RB1 and a top-20 national rusher before a left ankle injury that required season-ending surgery. Ankle surgery for a back is a real concern, but he has a full year before the 2028 draft. The market still likes him (KTC RB16), so he is a reasonable buy-low.

2028.name: Jordon Davison
2028.stats_2026: 8 g (cfbstats, through Wk 9): 91 rush, 439 yds, 7 TD; 6 rec, 11 yds. Out since a lower-body injury vs Northwestern on 10/31
2028.stats_2025: Team-high rushing TD total (Draft Sharks: 15 TD; ESPN cited 13)
2028.notes: He is a big goal-line back (7 TD in 8 games) but hurt his lower leg vs Northwestern and has not played since. The injury was described as week-to-week. Dierre Hill Jr. has outproduced him overall, and his minimal receiving role caps his fantasy ceiling (KTC RB24).

2028.name: Dierre Hill Jr.
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 119 rush, 589 yds, 5 TD; 25 rec, 289 yds, 1 TD
2028.stats_2025: Oregon freshman RB (rotation with Davison); totals not verified
2028.notes: He took over the lead role after Davison's injury (75 yds and 2 TD at Ohio State, 21 carries vs Michigan). He is the receiving half of Oregon's committee. He moves up from 26 to 21 but is unlikely to be a true bell cow in college (KTC RB27).

2028.name: Lotzeir Brooks
2028.class_note: He was a 2025 signee who played as a freshman in 2025, so he is 2028 eligible. FantraxHQ lists him as 2029, which appears to be an error.
2028.hs_rank: 4-star; about 25th WR in the composite (per Approaching the Pros)
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 39 rec, 597 yds, 4 TD
2028.notes: He is a dynamic slot receiver with a big-play rate (15.3 yds per catch), and he scored 3 TD in Alabama's last two games after scoring just 1 in the first nine. His small frame caps his NFL ceiling. He is useful but limited (KTC WR36).

2028.name: Dezmen Roebuck
2028.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Wk 11): 62 rec, 565 yds, 4 TD
2028.notes: He gets high-volume targets (about 6 catches per game) but averages only about 9 yds per catch, and his production faded in November. He has a slot-type frame. The volume is real, but his NFL size and ceiling are questions (KTC WR41).

2028.name: Gideon Davidson
2028.stats_2026: 9 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 109 rush, 544 yds, 5 TD; 5 rec, 10 yds
2028.notes: He is Clemson's lead back with solid efficiency (5.0 YPC), but he has almost no receiving role and missed the 11/7 Syracuse game. He has not had a 100-yard game since September. He is a mid-tier RB (KTC RB40).

2028.name: Linkon Cure
2028.hs_rank: Elite TE recruit (Approaching the Pros: second-highest TE recruit score in its model)
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 20 rec, 211 yds, 1 TD
2028.notes: He has played every game but has only modest production (about 2 catches per game). He is still the best TE in the class on pedigree and frame. He is a premium hold in TE-premium leagues only (KTC TE9).

2028.name: Vernell Brown III
2028.stats_2026: 4 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 17 rec, 271 yds, 2 TD. Has not played since 9/26 (knee injury)
2028.notes: He hurt his knee after Week 4 and has missed seven straight games, even though Florida said in mid-October that he was close to returning. He produced well when healthy (6-117-1 in the opener). His slight frame plus a lost season drop him from 23 to 26 (KTC WR25).

2028.name: Tavien St. Clair
2028.class_note: He was a 2025 signee who redshirted in 2025, so he is 2028 eligible. Most likely he returns in 2027 or later as Ohio State's starter instead of declaring early.
2028.stats_2026: 2 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 5/7, 52 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rush, 8 yds. No snaps since 9/19
2028.notes: He lost the job to Luke Fahey after Julian Sayin's elbow fracture and has not played since Week 3. Ryan Day said on 11/19 that St. Clair still has things to improve and that "it's just a matter of when." Writers expect him to consider the transfer portal. He falls from 21 to 27 on tools only (KTC QB36).

2028.name: Deuce Knight
2028.class_note: He was a 2025 Auburn signee who transferred to Ole Miss.
2028.stats_2026: 3 g (cfbstats page last updated 10/13): 4/8, 68 yds, 0 TD, 1 INT; 8 rush, 41 yds, 1 TD
2028.notes: He is a big, athletic QB who has been a seldom-used backup at Ole Miss. The market likes his tools more than his résumé (KTC QB25). He needs to win a starting job in 2027 to matter.

2028.name: Harlem Berry
2028.stats_2026: 11 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 32 rush, 202 yds, 1 TD (no carries since 10/24); receiving: 2 rec, 22 yds through Wk 8 (not re-verified)
2028.notes: He has top-20 recruit pedigree but has dropped out of LSU's rotation, with no carries in the Alabama, Texas or Tennessee games. He is light for an NFL workload. His stock keeps falling (KTC RB30).

2028.name: Julian Lewis
2028.class_note: He reclassified from the 2026 HS class to 2025 and redshirted at Colorado in 2025 after four appearances (CBS Sports, 11/25/2025), so he is a RS-Fr. in 2026 and 2028 eligible.
2028.stats_2026: 4 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 61/95, 733 yds, 6 TD, 2 INT; 15 rush, -45 yds, 1 TD (rushing from earlier source). Has not played since 9/26
2028.notes: He was benched for Isaac Wilson during the 9/26 loss to Baylor and has not played since. He was taken to the hospital after a medical emergency at the team facility on 10/28; the cause was not disclosed. He is undersized for an NFL QB and is a pure superflex stash.

2028.name: Kaliq Lockett
2028.hs_rank: On3 No. 30 overall, No. 6 WR (2025); Rivals No. 19
2028.stats_2026: 2 g (cfbstats, through Wk 12): 1 rec, -3 yds. Has not played since 9/19
2028.notes: He has top-30 recruit pedigree but had lower-leg surgery in the offseason and has missed every game since Week 3. 2026 is effectively a lost year. He is a pure talent stash.

2028.name: Quincy Porter
2028.class_note: He was a 2025 Ohio State signee who transferred to Notre Dame.
2028.notes: He has big-bodied pedigree, but he has no recorded 2026 stats (cfbstats lists him on Notre Dame's roster without a stat page). He is a deep stash.

2029.name: Jesse Legree
2029.class_note: He is a true freshman from the 2026 HS class (St. Frances Academy, Baltimore), so he is 2029 eligible.
2029.stats_2026: 11 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 78 rec, 1,418 yds, 15 TD (18.2 yds per catch)
2029.notes: He finished the regular season with 78 catches, 1,418 yds and 15 TD, and ESPN ranked him the No. 1 freshman in the country on Nov 6. His pace slowed after mid-October (one 100-yard game in his last four), but the season is historic and he has re-signed with Oregon State for 2027. KTC now ranks him above Chris Henry Jr. (No. 16 overall, WR8 on its devy board). His low recruiting profile and 170-lb frame are the remaining risks.

2029.name: Chris Henry Jr.
2029.hs_rank: 5-star; ESPN No. 7 overall, top-ranked WR in 2026 class (247 No. 32, On3 No. 31)
2029.stats_2026: 8 g logged (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 11 rec, 283 yds, 2 TD (25.7 yds per catch); no line listed for Nov 21 at Nebraska
2029.notes: His role stayed small behind Ohio State's veteran receivers, with 11 catches and no game above 3 catches. His per-catch explosiveness and top-WR pedigree are unchanged, and he projects as a starter in 2027-28. KTC still has him as a top-25 devy asset (No. 22, WR10), but Legree's season has moved ahead of him in market value.

2029.name: Jared Curtis
2029.hs_rank: 247 No. 3, ESPN No. 5, On3 No. 2 (2026); Vanderbilt's highest-rated signee ever
2029.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Nov 24): 182/289 (63.0%), 2,080 yds, 10 TD, 8 INT; 97 rush, 159 yds, 2 TD (rushing includes sacks)
2029.notes: He has started all season for Vanderbilt in the SEC and passed 2,000 yards, and ESPN ranked him the No. 15 freshman on Nov 6. Turnovers (8 INT) remain the main concern. A full season of SEC starts with elite pedigree now makes him the safest QB in the class.

2029.name: Faizon Brandon
2029.stats_2026: Through Wk 12 (Tiger Rag, Nov 21): 63/103, 726 yds, 9 TD, 1 INT; 60 rush, 195 yds, 3 TD. Wk 13 vs LSU (Nov 21, first start since Wk 5): 12 rush, 112 yds, 2 TD (passing line not verified; 1 INT reported)
2029.notes: A right shoulder injury from the Texas game cost him the job after five starts, and George MacIntyre started from mid-October. He returned as a change-of-pace runner and started vs LSU on Nov 21 with MacIntyre hurt, running for 112 yds and 2 TD, the first 100-yard rushing game by a true-freshman QB in Tennessee history. He drops one spot because Curtis started all year, but his pedigree and rushing upside keep him in the top tier of superflex QBs.

2029.name: Keisean Henderson
2029.hs_rank: 247 No. 1 overall, ESPN No. 4, On3 No. 4 (2026)
2029.stats_2026: 3 g known: 24/36, 351 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT; 15 rush, 93 yds, 1 TD (Wk 1-2 per Heavy; Wk 13 at West Virginia, Nov 21, per SI). Appearances between Wk 3 and Wk 12 not verified.
2029.notes: He made his first career start at West Virginia on Nov 21 with Conner Weigman injured, going 18 of 28 for 268 yds and a TD with no interceptions in a 34-31 win. He had not played for about two months before that. The start supports his path to Houston's 2027 starting job.

2029.name: Savion Hiter
2029.hs_rank: No. 1 RB in 2026 class; 247 No. 18, On3 No. 8 overall
2029.stats_2026: Through Wk 5 (old line): 46 rush, 145 yds, 2 TD; 5 rec, 59 yds. Wk 12 at Oregon (Nov 14): 13 rush, 107 yds, 1 TD. Wk 13 vs UCLA (Nov 21): 26 rush, 104 yds. 4 rush TD on the season per Michigan (Nov 16). Full-season line not verified.
2029.notes: He broke out late with back-to-back 100-yard games, becoming the first Michigan freshman since Mike Hart to do it, and carried 26 times vs UCLA as the lead back with Jordan Marshall injured. The early-season inefficiency is less of a worry now. KTC has him No. 47 overall (RB13).

2029.name: Trent Mosley
2029.stats_2026: 8 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 49 rec, 720 yds, 8 TD (14.7 yds per catch)
2029.notes: He has five 100-yard games in eight appearances, including 130 yds at Indiana, and was a midseason true-freshman All-American. The knee injury that cost him three games is the only blemish. KTC added him to its devy top 50 (No. 50, WR19), and he has become USC's best freshman receiver.

2029.name: Javian Mallory
2029.class_note: ESPN lists him as a 2026-class true freshman, so he is 2029 eligible.
2029.stats_2026: 11 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 94 rush, 624 yds, 9 TD (6.6 YPC); 11 rec, 147 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: He has been an efficient change-up to senior Mark Fletcher Jr. for a 10-1 Miami team, with 9 rushing TD and big games vs Florida A&M (142 yds) and Florida State (108 yds, 2 TD). ESPN ranked him the No. 4 freshman in the country on Nov 6. He projects as Miami's lead back in 2027.

2029.name: Jonaz Walton
2029.class_note: ESPN lists him as a 2026-class true freshman, so he is 2029 eligible.
2029.stats_2026: 9 g (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 94 rush, 655 yds, 5 TD (7.0 YPC); 9 rec, 101 yds
2029.notes: He has run for 7.0 yards per carry, with 181 yds vs Stanford and 141 vs Boston College, and ESPN ranked him the No. 5 freshman on Nov 6. He projects as Notre Dame's lead back once the current starters move on. Ourlads did not list a Nov 21 game.

2029.name: EJ Crowell
2029.class_note: He reclassified to enroll early, joining the 2026 class.
2029.stats_2026: 7 g (FOX Sports header, mid-Nov): 38 rush, 237 yds, 4 TD (6.2 YPC); rec line not verified
2029.notes: He was efficient when healthy but suffered a lower-leg injury vs Tennessee on Oct 17 and missed at least two games before being cleared on Nov 14. Three-star freshman Trae'shawn Brown has taken carries (5 rush TD through Week 9, per ESPN). KTC lists him among its 30-day devy fallers, so he drops three spots and a tier.

2029.name: Mark Bowman
2029.class_note: He reclassified from the 2027 HS class to 2026, so he should be 2029 eligible.
2029.stats_2026: 7 g logged (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 30 rec, 330 yds, 2 TD; no line listed for Nov 21 vs Maryland
2029.notes: He has caught passes in every game logged and was a midseason true-freshman All-American as a reclassified 17/18-year-old. ESPN ranked him the No. 24 freshman on Nov 6. He remains the best TE in the class.

2029.name: Kayden Dixon-Wyatt
2029.stats_2026: 10 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 35 rec, 534 yds, 4 TD
2029.notes: He had 100-yard games vs Fresno State and Oregon but cooled in the second half (no game over 5 catches after September). Mosley has passed him as USC's top freshman receiver. ESPN ranked him the No. 14 freshman on Nov 6.

2029.name: Tait Reynolds
2029.stats_2026: Season (Ourlads, checked Nov 25): 156/241 (64.7%), 1,449 yds, 3 TD, 4 INT; 110 rush, 334 yds, 2 TD (games not listed)
2029.notes: He has kept Clemson's starting job since September, and Clemson was 6-2 in his starts as of Nov 11, including a record 79-yard TD run at Florida State. His passing production is still thin (3 TD), and he was sacked 24 times in 8 games per ESPN. Starter reps keep his superflex value.

2029.name: Tristen Keys
2029.stats_2026: 9 g (StatMuse, through about Nov 7): 6 rec, 54 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: He has not grown his role, with only 6 catches in 9 games. His pedigree is still elite, but he is now a pure 2027 bet. He drops from 8th to 14th.

2029.name: Legend Glasker
2029.stats_2026: 11 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 47 rec, 735 yds, 5 TD (15.6 yds per catch)
2029.notes: He has 735 yds, including 131 at Colorado State and 118 at Utah, and ESPN ranked him the No. 6 freshman on Nov 6. He is a three-star recruit. His production moves him up a tier.

2029.name: Dia Bell
2029.notes: He is third on Texas's depth chart behind Arch Manning and KJ Lacey Jr., and I found no verified 2026 stats. A third-string role lowers his 2027 path somewhat. He is a superflex stash on pedigree.

2029.name: Jamal Rule
2029.stats_2026: 10 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 133 rush, 705 yds, 5 TD (5.3 YPC); 11 rec, 124 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: He has passed 700 rushing yards with 103 yds at Rutgers and 23 carries vs Ohio State, but has not scored since September and his efficiency fell from 6.8 to 5.3 YPC. He is a three-star with a clear role at Nebraska.

2029.name: Kenny Darby
2029.stats_2026: 10 g (cfbstats, through Nov 20): 49 rec, 601 yds, 3 TD
2029.notes: He has steady SEC volume and passed 600 yds, and ESPN ranked him the No. 8 freshman on Nov 6. He is a four-star recruit per ESPN.

2029.name: Calvin Russell III
2029.class_note: ESPN lists him as the No. 4 receiver in the 2026 class, so he is a true freshman and 2029 eligible.
2029.stats_2026: 7 g (Ourlads, Wk 6-13, through Nov 21): 49 rec, 518 yds, 3 TD
2029.notes: He missed the early season with an injury, then took on heavy volume, including 17 catches for 137 yds at NC State and 8 for 107 at Boston College. On Nov 17 he said he will return to Syracuse in 2027. ESPN calls him the No. 4 receiver in the 2026 class, which confirms his 2029 eligibility.

2029.name: Jalen Lott
2029.stats_2026: 6 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 20): 13 rec, 154 yds, 0 TD
2029.notes: He has a minor role in Oregon's receiver room, with no game above 3 catches. His five-star pedigree is the only case for him. He drops from 13th to 20th.

2029.name: Damon Ferguson Jr.
2029.stats_2026: 9 g (Ourlads, through Wk 10, Oct 31): 123 rush, 662 yds, 6 TD (5.4 YPC); 18 rec, 113 yds, 1 TD. No games logged after Oct 31.
2029.notes: He ran for 185 yds and 2 TD vs Georgia Tech on Oct 31, and ESPN ranked him the No. 12 freshman on Nov 6. Ourlads shows no games for him since then, and I could not confirm why.

2029.name: Derrek Cooper
2029.stats_2026: 8 g (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 32 rush, 114 yds, 1 TD (3.6 YPC); 3 rec, 37 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: His role shrank to 1-2 carries a game in November, and his efficiency is poor. He keeps his pedigree, but he drops from 15th to 22nd.

2029.name: Craig Dandridge
2029.stats_2026: 10 g (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 26 rec, 434 yds, 1 TD (16.7 yds per catch)
2029.notes: He has a big-play profile at Georgia but an inconsistent role (0 catches at Ole Miss). ESPN ranked him the No. 27 freshman on Nov 6.

2029.name: Kendre' Harrison
2029.stats_2026: 3 g (Ourlads, through Nov 20): 5 rec, 55 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: He has appeared in only 3 games, so a redshirt is possible. He is a TE-premium stash on pedigree.

2029.name: Ethan Feaster
2029.stats_2026: 9 g (Ourlads, through Wk 12, Nov 14): 11 rec, 101 yds, 0 TD
2029.notes: He is fourth among USC's freshman receivers, with no game above 3 catches. He is a hold on pedigree only.

2029.name: Cederian Morgan
2029.class_note: FantasyPros and KTC list him as a devy WR. I did not independently confirm 2026 HS class.
2029.stats_2026: 3 g (Ourlads, through Wk 13, Nov 21): 4 rec, 81 yds, 2 TD
2029.notes: He has scored twice on 4 catches but has almost no role. He is a stash.

2029.name: Legend Bey
2029.stats_2026: Season (Ourlads, checked Nov 25): 19 rush, 80 yds; 5 rec, 56 yds, 1 TD (games not listed)
2029.notes: He exited the Kent State game on Sept 19 with an injury and has had a small role behind Bo Jackson. He has elite speed and a long-term path if Jackson declares.

2029.name: Kaiden Prothro
2029.stats_2026: 1 g (Ourlads, Wk 1, Sept 5): 1 rec, 16 yds, 1 TD
2029.notes: He has appeared in only one game, so a redshirt is likely. He is a TE-premium stash on pedigree.

method_by_year.2027: The 2027 class is players who will be draft eligible for the April 2027 NFL draft: mainly 2024 HS grads (true juniors and redshirt sophomores in 2026) plus older players who returned after the 2026 draft or transferred, with anyone drafted in April 2026 excluded. We started from Draft Sharks' superflex rookie board (Oct. 1), The Big Board superflex rankings (Oct. 26), KeepTradeCut devy values, TWSN's August superflex list, and NFL big boards from Mel Kiper (Oct. 15) and The Game Haus (Oct. 28). We moved players off consensus only when the 2026 season clearly changed the picture: injuries (Moore, Sayin, Hardy, Lacy, Coleman-Williams), a jump in NFL draft stock (Mestemaker, Mensah, Simmons), or a big production gain or drop. QBs who project as first- or second-round picks get a superflex bump, and players likely to return to school are marked down and flagged in class_note. 2026 stats come from cfbstats.com team pages (through Oct. 23-29), with StatSniper used for some QB rushing lines. Nov. 25 refresh: 2026 stat lines were refreshed from cfbstats.com team and national leader pages covering games through Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026 (Week 12), pulled Nov. 24-25, 2026. Ranks, tiers and notes use Kiper's Nov. 19 big board, PFN's Nov. 21 seven-round mock, Draft Sharks' Nov. 4 superflex rookie rankings, and injury and return-to-school reports from Oct. 28 to Nov. 17, 2026.
method_by_year.2028: Nov. 25 refresh: Stats were refreshed on 2026-11-25 from cfbstats.com player game logs and season pages (most lines run through Week 12, 11/21/2026; where a page lagged, the line says which week it runs through), with injury and depth-chart news from Oct 3 to Nov 19, 2026 reports. Rankings were checked against KeepTradeCut's live superflex devy rankings (Week 12, 2026). Aneyas Williams was dropped because he is a 2024 recruit (2027 draft eligible). Jesse Legree, Tristen Keys and Keisean Henderson were not added because they are 2026 enrollees (2029 class).
method_by_year.2029: Nov. 25 refresh: Refreshed Nov 25, 2026 from Ourlads and cfbstats game logs (most through Nov 21, Week 13), FOX Sports/StatMuse player pages, team and news reports from Nov 2026, ESPN's Nov 6 top-40 freshmen list, and KeepTradeCut's live devy board. I could not find October-November 2026 updates from FantasyPros, Draft Sharks or FantraxHQ, so their older ranks in the notes are from the prior refresh.
